text.p: Peter Salathiel, Inco Ltd's executive vice-president in charge of marketing, said on Tuesday he will retire at the end of the year.
Salathiel, 56, will be replaced by Peter Goudie, now the president and managing director of Inco Pacific Ltd.
"It's the end of an era around here," Inco spokesman Bob Purcell said in a phone interview. "Peter has been a marketing guru for as long as I can remember."
Salathiel joined Inco in 1965 as a market research analyst and gradually moved up through the company. He was appointed executive vice-president in April 1991.
Goudie's position at Inco Pacific will be filled by James Shih, now director of Inco's Taiwan branch, the company said.
